defect.statement: The EXECUTED effect receipt stored a bounded diagnostic in `output` while its only digest, `output_sha256`, hashed the full backend output. The digest therefore did not correspond to the retained bytes, no byte counts were recorded, and nothing in the record disclosed that truncation had occurred.

observed_instance.note: Measured by reading the receipt produced by a real harness_test effect under this grant, not by constructing a synthetic example.

tdd_sequence.change: Inline receipt field construction lifted into the pure production constructor `effect_output_fields/1`. Field names, order and values byte-identical; no behavioural change.
Added `executed_receipt_digest_covers_the_bytes_it_retains_test` asserting the integrity contract against the existing production constructor.
tdd_sequence.red_evidence: The build succeeded, so every symbol referenced by the assertion already existed; the failure is a gleeunit should.equal panic on absent and non-corresponding digest fields, not a missing-symbol compile error.

tdd_sequence.change: `effect_output_fields/1` now emits `output`, `output_sha256` (full output, name and meaning preserved), `output_retained_sha256`, `output_retained_bytes`, `output_bytes` and `output_retention`.

test_manifest.executed_through: harness_test over the Gleam successor MCP; no direct test invocation

coverage.note: 8192 three-byte graphemes exceed the 16384-byte bound, so the production fallback retains text that is not output bytes

retention_classification.invariant: output_retained_sha256 covers exactly the bytes stored in output, in all three cases

live_harness_note: The serving harness process kept the control modules pinned by the grant for the whole session, so its own receipts were produced by the pre-fix constructor. The repaired constructor is exercised by the rebuilt code inside the harness_test subprocess. A launcher activation that serves the new fields needs fresh reviewed control IDs.
residuals: No independent peer or formal artifact is asserted by this record; Codex review is outstanding.
No live harness receipt yet carries the new fields; that requires a re-reviewed launcher grant.
`output_retention` classifies retention; it does not recover the dropped prefix. A diagnostic whose signal is in the prefix is still lost, now explicitly rather than silently.
The 16384-byte fallback remains in `development.gleam`, which is outside this grant's write scope.
